title: [Identification and Underlying Mechanisms of Immune Cell- and Senescence-Related Biomarkers in Atrial Fibrillation].
authors: Huang, Wei; Liu, Enzhao; Fu, Huaying
journal: Sichuan da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Sichuan University. Medical science edition
one_liner_zh: 该文通过WGCNA和LASSO识别房颤免疫细胞与衰老相关生物标志物，并做分子对接，但核心是疾病标志物筛选而非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，仅涉及TF调控网络预测，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the molecular mechanisms of immune cells (ICs)- and senescence-related biomarkers in atrial fibrillation (AF). METHODS: In this study, immune cell-related genes (ICRGs) were obtained using weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) based on the GSE2240 dataset. Subsequently, the intersection of ICRGs, senescence-related genes (SRGs), and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) derived from differential expression analysis between AF and sinus rhythm (SR) groups was obtained to screen candidate genes. Biomarkers were further identified using the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) algorithm and validated in the GSE115571 dataset. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), GeneMANIA network construction, molecular regulatory network construction, and molecular docking were performed to investigate the molecular mechanisms of the biomarkers in AF. A total of 8 male Sprague-Dawley rats of 87 weeks old and weighing 632-656 g were randomly assigned to the AF group and the sinus rhythm (SR) group (n = 4 per group). An AF rat model was established. The mRNA expression levels of myosin light chain kinase (MYLK) and insulin-like growth factor binding protein 2 (IGFBP2) in rat myocardial tissue were measured using reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). RESULTS: Two biomarkers, MYLK and IGFBP2, were identified. GSEA revealed that MYLK was significantly enriched in the olfactory transduction pathway, whereas IGFBP2 was significantly enriched in the extracellular matrix-receptor interaction pathway. The GeneMANIA network demonstrated functional similarity between these biomarkers and 20 other genes. In addition, MYLK was regulated by 28 transcription factors (TFs) and 41 microRNAs (miRNAs), whereas IGFBP2 was regulated by 63 TFs and 4 miRNAs, including TAF1 and MIRT020526. Drug prediction analysis indicated that only MYLK had potential interactions with 3 drugs, among which Tozasertib exhibited the strongest binding affinity to MYLK, with a binding energy of －7.8 kcal/mol. RT-qPCR results showed that IGFBP2 mRNA expression was upregulated and MYLK mRNA expression was downregulated in myocardial tissue of rats in the AF group compared with the SR group (both P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: In this study, MYLK and IGFBP2 are identified as AF-related biomarkers, and their potential molecular mechanisms are elucidated, providing new theoretical insights into AF research.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨免疫细胞（ICs）和衰老相关生物标志物在心房颤动（AF）中的分子机制。方法：本研究基于GSE2240数据集，采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）获取免疫细胞相关基因（ICRGs）。随后，取ICRGs、衰老相关基因（SRGs）与AF和窦性心律（SR）组间差异表达分析所得差异表达基因（DEGs）的交集，以筛选候选基因。进一步使用最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）算法鉴定生物标志物，并在GSE115571数据集中进行验证。采用基因集富集分析（GSEA）、GeneMANIA网络构建、分子调控网络构建和分子对接，探讨生物标志物在AF中的分子机制。将8只87周龄、体重632-656 g的雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠随机分为AF组和窦性心律（SR）组（每组n=4）。建立AF大鼠模型。采用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）检测大鼠心肌组织中肌球蛋白轻链激酶（MYLK）和胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白2（IGFBP2）的mRNA表达水平。结果：鉴定出两个生物标志物MYLK和IGFBP2。GSEA显示，MYLK显著富集于嗅觉转导通路，而IGFBP2显著富集于细胞外基质-受体相互作用通路。GeneMANIA网络显示这些生物标志物与其他20个基因存在功能相似性。此外，MYLK受28个转录因子（TFs）和41个微小RNA（miRNAs）调控，而IGFBP2受63个TFs和4个miRNAs调控，包括TAF1和MIRT020526。药物预测分析表明，仅MYLK与3种药物存在潜在相互作用，其中Tozasertib与MYLK的结合亲和力最强，结合能为－7.8 kcal/mol。RT-qPCR结果显示，与SR组相比，AF组大鼠心肌组织中IGFBP2 mRNA表达上调，MYLK mRNA表达下调（均P < 0.05）。结论：本研究将MYLK和IGFBP2鉴定为AF相关生物标志物，并阐明其潜在分子机制，为AF研究提供新的理论见解。
